summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season with an exciting new squad featuring fresh additions and a returning player. The Ramblers suffered a narrow defeat to St Helens in their recent friendly, where their opponents' clinical finishing made the difference in a competitive match. With three new kits in place and player details being released, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities as they prepare for their promotion push.
